decisions.reason: Grounds the all-or-nothing failure in the boot log's classic-script combo and client.js's top-level imports, explaining zero entries register on one compile error; names dsh-typert-registry as the first-awaited innocent entry, and scopes ESM illegality to classic scripts only.

Bisects the patch insert rows, gives cheap static checks (ESM grep, wrapper grep, classic-script parse with an 'or equivalent' hedge), and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) wrapper with package-name identity, host React via factory require, and module.exports/apply/inject exports.

Uses plugin-apply-error.txt to explain parent-owned declaration and undefined apply order, shows the exact ctx.slots.inject callback wrapping the register call so it waits for the declaration, and correctly restricts registrant fields to name/id/order (label) while forbidding kind/scope.

Explains the combo is composed once at boot so edits and refresh change nothing, prescribes full stop/restart with taskkill /PID /T /F, refresh and plugin-list verification, and attributes EADDRINUSE to the orphaned old process holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Proposes per-bundle classic-script validation and owner attribution at boot/combo failure instead of blaming the first awaited entry, and an authoring checklist covering the loader factory, host React, deferred cross-entry slots, and restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: All affirmative advice follows the contracts (classic wrapper, inject-wrapped deferred registration, no kind/scope on registrant, host restart over refresh); the bad bare-ESM and immediate-register forms appear only as rejected diagnoses of the user's code.
